characters.description: A hunted death wizard who has returned from the afterlife. Damage left by demonic magic still threatens his sanity, and the protection supplied by Ember's distant magic is weakening while he tries to conceal four dangerous tokens.
characters.name: Kael

characters.description: A demon seeking four afterlife tokens that Kael has hidden. Their concealment is temporary, leaving Kael responsible for moving them before the demon can recover them.
characters.name: the archdemon

characters.description: Kael's wife and a Fae leader working in the Fae Islands. Her magic has helped stabilize Kael's damaged mind, but distance and time are reducing its effect. She is leading work away from Kael when his allies divide between reinforcing her and concealing the tokens.
characters.name: Ember

characters.description: A longstanding ally of Kael who argues that the teenage pikeman should be allowed to join the dangerous mission to conceal the tokens. He is among the trusted companions helping Kael decide how to divide their forces between Ember's relief mission and the token threat.
characters.name: Max

characters.description: The pirate captain commanding a fleet equipped with cannons. He offers the ships to Kael's alliance after ancient forces seize the fleet's engineer and violate an earlier transport agreement.
characters.name: Dominic

characters.description: An ancient assassin and one of Kael's protectors. She joins the force sent to reinforce Ember.
characters.name: the elven guardian

characters.description: A young spear fighter considered for Kael's token mission. Max supports taking him, but Kael first intends to determine whether he can function under extreme fear. His lack of experience makes that decision important because the proposed route involves dangers beyond ordinary military service.
characters.name: the teenage pikeman

characters.description: The specialist responsible for the pirate fleet's cannons and gunpowder. Ancient forces have taken him prisoner, creating the danger that his weapons knowledge could be used against the southern lands.
characters.name: the human engineer

characters.description: A civilian Ritek historian imprisoned beside the human engineer. She opposes the renewed war and receives his help after being placed in captivity. Her dissent shows that support for conquest is not universal among the Ritek, even as their interrogators continue seeking the engineer's knowledge.
characters.name: the Ritek dissident

characters.description: A vampire who helps Kael stage a test of the teenage pikeman. Her venom and frightening transformed appearance make the false interrogation convincing. She is trusted with a dangerous role in the test and remains one of the companions supporting Kael's preparations.
characters.name: the vampire companion

characters.description: A surviving priestess who conceals an escape operation after the seal island's defenders fall. She spends life force to maintain protective magic while hiding selected Ritek and Kohari for an attempt to seize a pirate vessel.
characters.name: the Nazca priestess

characters.description: An allied necromancer ruler who helps Kael prepare a burial ground as the hiding place for a demonic token. He works with Kael and the burial-ground caretakers to place the object behind glyphs, undead defenders, and wall-bound golems without expecting civilians to resist an archdemon directly.
characters.name: the necromancer king

characters.description: An allied necromancer ruler who joins Kael's effort to conceal a demonic token behind the defenses of a large burial ground. She helps coordinate a hiding place protected by marked caretakers, undead defenders, and golems while Kael prepares to move the remaining tokens elsewhere.
characters.name: the necromancer queen

characters.description: A southern ruler who can be difficult and wary but has supported the allied necromancers. A false report that Kael plans to assassinate him leads to Kael's party being detained near his palace.
characters.name: the southern king

characters.description: A royal officer and former member of a desert monster-hunting order. The southern king assigns her to escort Kael toward the order's territory as part of a negotiated exchange.
characters.name: the royal guard commander

characters.description: A spirit living within Kael's mind. The spirit can restore his lost ability to understand and speak the Araki language, but warns that using this power opens a dangerous door.
characters.name: Kael's resident spirit

characters.description: The mage commander of the scorpion people. The commander accepts custody of a demon-linked token from Kael and agrees that the community will guard it, while preserving their claim to avenge one of their people if Kael returns.
characters.name: the scorpion mage commander

characters.description: A former Dead Sister traveling with her daughter and displaced survivors. She remains hidden from Kael while quietly killing bounty hunters who are preparing to capture him. Her protection allows his party to continue toward the mountains without learning that she is nearby.
characters.name: the former Dead Sister

characters.description: The organizer and financier of a permitted caravan seeking a hidden ancient crypt near the archdemon's caverns. He offers Kael's group transport and supplies in exchange for magical protection on the journey.
characters.name: the antiquities collector

characters.description: The ancient-aligned magistrate governing Bender's Pass. He recognizes the destination of Kael's caravan, suppresses the party's magic, and uses the other travelers as leverage to force an expedition for binding stones.
characters.name: the local magistrate

characters.description: The unusually communicative wraith guarding the Heliscore ruins. It responds to Kael's death magic, permits him to enter alone, and guides him to a sealed underground laboratory.
characters.name: the wraith lord

characters.description: A caravan adventurer revealed to be an ancient being in disguise. He opposes Ritek rule, kills the magistrate before an alert can be sent, and preserves the binding stones Kael concealed.
characters.name: the ancient brother

characters.description: One of a surviving pair of ancient siblings. She remains undecided about Ritek rule and continues watching Kael while waiting for proof that he could matter in a larger conflict.
characters.name: the ancient sister

characters.description: The Ritek ruler who makes recovering her people's hidden magic a higher priority than healing the Black Chasm. She orders the deaths of Kael, all death wizards including Black Sun children, and her own daughter, the Nazca priestess.
characters.name: the Ritek ruler

characters.description: The dragonkin ruler who holds Kael to a one-year bargain to recover her daughter and the dragons stranded in another dimension. She requires him to remain on the islands until he can attempt the rescue.
characters.name: the dragonkin queen

characters.description: The dragonkin queen's lost daughter, found as a blind grey dragon after roughly a thousand years in another dimension. She has survived the fading of magic there, although living in dragon form has left her largely feral.
characters.name: the dragonkin daughter

characters.description: A wizard who takes the last two demon-linked tokens from Kael in Death Valley. He seals one inside cave stone and carries the other within runic clothing, then refuses to transport Kael's party across a chasm he considers deadly for several travelers.
characters.name: the Mahalan wizard

characters.description: The leader of a Kohari group hunting children born under Black Suns with Ritek institutional approval. He ambushes Kael with soul-targeting magic and poison arrows, then escapes after losing a hand.
characters.name: the Kohari leader

characters.description: Kael's daughter and a child born under the first new Black Sun. She lives in New Cairnwood with her mother, who has kept her safe alongside other magically gifted children.
characters.name: Kayla

characters.description: A teenage death wizard living under the former Dead Sister's protection in New Cairnwood. Her dark magic is powerful but unstable, and she uses it to help defend the settlement.
characters.name: Kenna

characters.description: Kenna's teenage brother and a defender of New Cairnwood. His blue shield can protect the settlement's gate from both arrows and magic. He uses that defensive ability beside his sister when tax collectors threaten the community, showing that the siblings already share responsibility for its safety.
characters.name: Tanner

characters.description: An ambitious mayor pursuing mining rights in land protected as a massacre burial site. He proposes that Kael join a new kingdom being planned with the Blackwall warlord.
characters.name: Devon Waller

characters.description: The military partner in Devon Waller's proposed new kingdom. Devon presents the warlord as the planned general for an expansion alliance and asks Kael to cooperate with them.
characters.name: the Blackwall warlord

characters.description: A Ritek conspirator who participates in the trap at the Blackwall fortress. He acknowledges a connection between interference at the Black Chasm and damage to mortal magic, then escapes after being wounded.
characters.name: the Siddic priest

characters.description: A memory-impaired divine figure with an unexplained connection to a remote pre-cataclysm fortress. He locates it on an old map, warns Kael about the region, and gives him an ancient dagger that must not be altered.
characters.name: the fallen god

characters.description: A curse-bound guardian who appears in the abandoned village near the fortress. She warns Kael's advance party to turn back and says her more powerful brother will stop them if they continue.
characters.name: the cursed female guardian

characters.description: The immense lantern-bearing protector of the basilica and castle. It arrives after the female guardian confronts Kael's group, forcing the advance party toward a trap beneath the altar.
characters.name: the giant guardian

characters.description: A demon who keeps the curse-bound guardian alive because it anchors the fortress's curse. She intervenes when Kael's group wounds the creature and explains why killing it will not end the danger.
characters.name: the demon caretaker

characters.description: The ancient Northman released when the giant guardian's remains form a cocoon. He explains that an invasive infection transformed him and that he used dangerous red-magic runes to hold back the fortress's purple corruption.
characters.name: the ancient Northman

characters.description: A Ritek priest who searches the Black Chasm's magical network for his people's lost original power. After recovering a limited source, he is appointed to command the new outpost built around it.
characters.name: the Ritek outpost commander

characters.description: A knight-mage from a neighboring kingdom who receives covert support to investigate Ritek interference. Working under the cover of studying Ritek magic, the investigator seeks corroboration for reports linking the Ritek to the failed dragon rescue.
characters.name: the knight-mage
